# Investor på tilbudsjagt: Her er to aktier, jeg køber nu

**Feed**: borsen-podcast  
**Published**: 2026-11-11  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This Danish Børsen Investor episode (recorded around the Vestas Q3 report) asks whether to buy stocks when prices fall, as AI and chip stocks sell off and money moves into defensive healthcare names. The two guests are Peter Bækgaard, a stock picker who screens on return on invested capital, and Michael from Regulær Invest, who builds his portfolio around macro scenarios. Michael says he is adding cyclical electrification and building-materials exposure (ABB, Inwido) because defensives have run up. Peter pitches BioGaia and stays away from AI stocks such as Nvidia because he cannot forecast them. The mood is mixed: the guests are cautious on AI and IPOs but positive on selected Nordic names.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 INWI — Inwido | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Guest Michael bought at 150-155 and still sees upside at about 198; around 14x 2027 P/E with possibly low estimates.

#### Reasoning

One of the cheapest Swedish serial acquirers, with strong management. Buying companies at low multiples creates value. Renovation demand supports the business while new-build activity is at a trough, and organic growth has turned positive at 2-5%. The guest thinks consensus estimates are too low.

#### Sell Triggers

- if higher interest rates choke construction activity further
- if organic growth turns negative again
- if acquisitions are made at high multiples

> *"Den handler på cirka 14 gange p i 27. Og vi tror faktisk, at estimaterne måske kan være til den lave side"*

---

### 🟢 ABB — ABB | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Guest Michael bought on the pullback from about 1050 for European electrification exposure.

#### Reasoning

Electrification and European energy independence give multi-year growth that is not directly tied to AI. The pullback alongside AI stocks brought the valuation to a reasonable level, although the multiple is above what he usually pays. It is a supplementary position, not a 10% weight.

#### Sell Triggers

- if data-center build-out slows sharply
- if valuation re-expands beyond growth potential

> *"Så jeg synes elektrificering, det er der, hvor vi har lyst til at være."*

---

### 🟢 BIOG-B — BioGaia | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Peter holds it and buys more on dips: Q3 organic growth 23%, profit up about 60%, chairman bought about SEK 90m. Michael will take a fresh look.

#### Reasoning

Documented probiotic efficacy gives a competitive edge, and taking over distribution itself drives double-digit US growth. ROIC is high and the margin is about 33%. Revenue of about SEK 2bn could double or more. The chairman's insider buying signals confidence. The stock is expensive at over 30x earnings and capital allocation has been weak; a December CMD could bring buybacks.

#### Sell Triggers

- if top-line growth decelerates
- if capital allocation stays poor
- if the valuation multiple fails to compress via growth

> *"det er en af dem, som... som jeg altid kigger på, at jeg skal købe op, når den falder"*

---

### 🟡 VWS — Vestas | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Michael holds 2.5% and will review it after the Q3 miss; Peter avoids it on ROIC grounds.

#### Reasoning

Michael is betting on margin recovery and European electrification and energy security, and sees order intake as strong. The margin journey is slower than he hoped, the service business has been hurt by cost inflation, and Chinese competition is a risk. He may sell if no further upside appears. Peter avoids it because ROIC is below 15% after tax.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the margin improvement is delayed again next quarter
- if Chinese competitors gain international share
- if no further value upside is visible

> *"I det vi ikke kan se yderligere værdistigningspotentiale i aktien, så bliver den sparket ud."*

---

### 🟡 MAERSK-B — A.P. Møller-Mærsk | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Michael's 8-9% position is down 15% after the report; he has not sold.

#### Reasoning

The logistics and terminals businesses alone justify the valuation, so the container business comes almost for free. Risks are falling freight rates, new ship orders cutting into buybacks, and unclear capital allocation.

#### Sell Triggers

- if buybacks are cut in favour of ship purchases
- if freight rates collapse
- if capital allocation communication disappoints at full-year results

> *"Vi har ikke solgt aktien. Vi synes, at fremgangen i logistik og terminalforretninger er ganske fin."*

---

### 🟡 CHEMM — Chemometec | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Held in the All Star portfolio, up 60%; Peter loves the business but notes a very high valuation.

#### Reasoning

Margins are about 60% and growth has resumed, and the stock is up about 200% since March. Peter praises the business quality but sees the valuation as stretched, so this is a hold rather than adding.

#### Sell Triggers

- if growth stalls again
- if another CEO change happens

> *"Og jeg elsker deres forretning."*

---

### ⛔ NVDA — Nvidia | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Peter stays away from AI stocks despite low P/E after the drop; CEO scandal and capex-cut risk.

#### Reasoning

Citing Howard Marks, Peter says the AI market five years out cannot be forecast. A possible 10% fall in data-center capex in 2028 is not priced in, and the CEO spy scandal adds risk.

> *"Det er fuldstændig umuligt at forudsige, hvordan markedet kommer til at se ud om fem år. Og det gør jo nok, at man skal holde sig væk fra det."*

---

### ⛔ SNDK — Sandisk | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Peter looked at it after the drop but considers AI hardware unforecastable.

#### Reasoning

Earnings depend on AI capex, which may decline in 2028. A low P/E may reflect peak earnings.

---

### 🟢 ROCK-B — Rockwool | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Michael added it in recent months after a share-price setback, at a valuation he called reasonable.

#### Reasoning

Bought on a pullback at a reasonable valuation as part of a balanced macro portfolio; few details were given.

---

### 🟢 NKT — NKT | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Michael added it in recent months on a share-price setback.

#### Reasoning

Bought on a pullback; it fits his theme of European electrification growth pockets.

---

### 🟢 AMBU-B — Ambu | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Michael bought it over the summer as a defensive holding.

#### Reasoning

Added for defensive exposure on a price setback. He warns that high-multiple medtech is sensitive to interest rates.

#### Sell Triggers

- if interest rates rise further, compressing high multiples

---

### 🟢 SYDB — Sydbank | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Michael added it in recent months.

#### Reasoning

Bank exposure that benefits from higher interest rates, part of his multi-scenario portfolio.
